name: Compact Readiness Guard
summary: Warn before compaction when uncommitted changes or pending ledger claims would silently lose context.
description: On PreCompact, count dirty worktree changes and read pending claims from the latest ledger checkpoint, then emit a bounded system warning when either exists. Observing only; compaction proceeds.
refuses: It does not block, delay, or alter the observed event; it records or reports only.
It does not execute submitted content, call an LLM, or transmit any data off the machine.
It does not treat unreadable, symlinked, or oversized state as valid evidence.

entrypoints.purpose: Warn when compaction would hide dirty state or pending claims.
